limitations: 'Permitted' is carried by the control-law clauses of #010 (FullControl) rather than by a formalisation of Wilken-Weiermann section 2.1; the reviews retain the existing formal interpretation of control laws, canonical assignments and original-domain circuit semantics
One procedure per relation (weak, strict, equality) rather than the relation as a runtime tag; the review judged this immaterial
The procedure may diverge on programs that realize no policy; on realizing programs it halts on every raw input and is correct on codes of typed terms whose free variables all have ground type
Clauses (ii) and (iii) are the accepted no-decider statements for every selected control and policy together with the literal policy- and control-independent reduction programs
Compiled and verified on the local continuation host; build receipts are host-local
